Pimecrolimus Cream, 1% is not indicated for use in children less than 2 years of age [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) , Use in Specific Populations (8.4) ] . Pimecrolimus Cream, 1% is a calcineurin inhibitor immunosuppressant indicated as second-line therapy for the short-term and non-continuous chronic treatment of mild to moderate atopic dermatitis in non-immunocompromised adults and children 2 years of age and older, who have failed to respond adequately to other topical prescription treatments, or when those treatments are not advisable. ( 1 )"], "pediatric_use": ["8.4 Pediatric Use Pimecrolimus Cream, 1% is not indicated for use in children less than 2 years of age. The long-term safety and effects of Pimecrolimus Cream, 1% on the developing immune system are unknown. Three Phase 3 pediatric trials were conducted involving 1114 subjects 2-17 years of age. Two trials were 6-week randomized vehicle-controlled trials with a 20-week open-label phase and one was a vehicle-controlled (up to 1 year) safety trial with the option for sequential topical corticosteroid use. Of these subjects, 542 (49%) were 2-6 years of age. In the short-term trials, 11% of Pimecrolimus subjects did not complete these trials and 1.5% of Pimecrolimus subjects discontinued due to adverse events.
